PERSONAL // CYBERPUNK 2077

MY NIGHT CITY
ACHIEVEMENTS.

4,500HOURS IN
NIGHT CITY
01COMPLETED THE ENTIRE GAME

Finished the full Cyberpunk 2077 experience and explored Night City from start to finish.

02500+ MOD COLLECTION

A personal mod collection of roughly 500+ mods, built around customising the way I experience the game.

03VALERIE // FEMALE V

I played as female V — Valerie — throughout my main Cyberpunk run.

04PANAM / JUDY

My favourite romance options were Panam Palmer and Judy Alvarez.

05PHANTOM LIBERTY

I loved the Phantom Liberty expansion and its darker spy-thriller atmosphere.

06SOLOMON REED

My favourite Phantom Liberty NPC was Solomon Reed.

07JOHNNY SILVERHAND

A genuine love-hate relationship with Johnny Silverhand.

08NIGHT CITY // OBSESSION

4,500 hours later, the neon, rain, architecture and atmosphere still keep pulling me back.
